$comment: Contract for the DrainNotifications server-side command (AD-003, PP-15, OD-030). Recovery path for outbox rows the asynchronous NotificationDrainPlugin step cannot reach — queued before the step was registered, failed against a mailbox since approved, or missing a recipient since resolved. Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 7=Integer, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_DrainNotifications
customApi.description: Re-drains a bounded batch of al_notification rows that are Pending or Failed, sending each through Dataverse server-side email from the account the command runs as (PP-15, AD-035, BR-009). Sent rows are never re-sent. Requires Manage on permission.manage.

requestParameters.name: MaxRows
requestParameters.description: Most rows to attempt in this run. Omitted, zero or negative means 50; anything above 250 is clamped to 250, so one invocation can never send an unbounded number of emails. Re-run to work through a backlog.

responseProperties.name: Sent
responseProperties.description: Rows handed to server-side email successfully and stamped Sent.

responseProperties.name: Failed
responseProperties.description: Rows that could not be sent. Each carries al_failurereason saying why, and stays retryable.
